policy: A source may be used for model training only after its current terms, upstream rights, attribution requirements, storage, and redistribution restrictions have been reviewed and explicitly approved.

sources.notes: Access token and API availability do not establish permission to retain or use historical data for model training.
Current terms and rights to underlying statistics require review.
Identify the exact data provider, contract, and applicable terms before any training use.
Review current API terms, plan restrictions, storage, and derived-data permissions.
